title: Exponential reliability
caption: With a constant failure rate λ = 10⁻⁵ per hour, R(t) = e^(−λt). Over 1000 hours R = e^(−0.01) = 0.99; at t = MTTF = 1/λ = 99999.99999999999 hours the reliability is e⁻¹ = 0.368, so only 37% of components survive to the mean time to failure.
alt: Reliability falling exponentially from 1, with marked points of 0.990 at 1000 hours and 0.368 at 100 000 hours.
description: R(t) = exp(−λt) with λ = 10⁻⁵ h⁻¹; time in thousands of hours.
